browser.disableToolUseDescription: Prevent Caret from using browser actions (e.g. launch, click, type).
browser.viewportSizeDescription: Set the size of the browser viewport for screenshots and interactions.
browser.remoteConnectionDescription1: Enable Caret to use your Chrome
browser.remoteConnectionDescription2: . You can specify a custom path below. Using a remote browser connection requires starting Chrome in debug mode
browser.remoteConnectionDescription3: manually (`--remote-debugging-port=9222`) or using the button below. Enter the host address or leave it blank for automatic discovery.
browser.customArgsDescription: Space-separated arguments to pass to the browser executable.
browser.remoteBrowserDescription: Using remote browser connection allows you to run a separate instance of Chrome. You can specify a custom path below. To use remote browser connection, you must start Chrome in debug mode.
browser.debugModeDescription: You can start it manually (--remote-debugging-port=9222) or using the button below. Please enter the host.

terminal.defaultProfileDescription: Select the default terminal profile. This will be used when starting new terminal sessions.
terminal.shellTimeoutDescription: Time in seconds to wait for shell integration to successfully complete. If this time is exceeded, the terminal will open without shell integration.
terminal.aggressiveReuseDescription: Reuse existing available terminals when new terminal sessions are requested if possible.
terminal.outputLimitDescription: Maximum number of lines to include in terminal output when executing commands. If this number is exceeded, intermediate lines will be removed to save tokens.

features.enableCheckpointsDescription: Enables the extension to save checkpoints of your workspace during tasks. This uses git internally and may not work correctly for large workspaces.
features.enableMcpMarketplaceDescription: Enables the MCP Marketplace tab, allowing you to discover and install MCP servers.
features.enableRichMcpDisplayDescription: Enables rich formatting for MCP responses. If disabled, responses will be displayed as plain text.
features.mcpDisplayModeDescription: Controls how MCP responses are displayed: plain text, rich formatting with links/images, or markdown rendering.
features.collapseMcpResponsesDescription: Sets the default display mode for MCP response panels
features.openaiReasoningEffortDescription: Reasoning effort for the OpenAI family of models(applies to all OpenAI model providers)
features.strictPlanModeDescription: Enforces strict tool use while in plan mode, preventing file edits.
features.focusChainDescription: Enables enhanced task progress tracking and automatic focus chain list management throughout tasks.
features.focusChainReminderIntervalDescription: Interval (in messages) to remind Caret about its focus chain checklist (1-100). Lower values provide more frequent reminders.
features.autoCompactDescription: Enables advanced context management system which uses LLM based condensing for next-gen models.

autoApprove.title: Auto-approve Settings
autoApprove.tooltip: Configure auto-approval settings for various actions
autoApprove.label: Auto-approve
autoApprove.maxRequestsTooltip: Maximum number of consecutive requests that can be auto-approved

enableAutoApprove.label: Enable auto-approve
enableAutoApprove.description: Turns auto-approve functionality on or off.

enableAll.label: Toggle all
enableAll.description: Turns all actions on or off.

readFiles.label: Read project files
readFiles.description: Allows Caret to read files within your workspace.

readFilesExternally.label: Read any files
readFilesExternally.description: Allows Caret to read any files on your computer.

editFiles.label: Edit project files
editFiles.description: Allows Caret to modify files within your workspace.

editFilesExternally.label: Edit any files
editFilesExternally.description: Allows Caret to modify any files on your computer.

executeSafeCommands.label: Execute safe commands
executeSafeCommands.description: Allows Caret to execute safe terminal commands. Approval will still be required if the model deems a command potentially destructive.

executeAllCommands.label: Execute all commands
executeAllCommands.description: Allows Caret to execute any terminal commands. Use at your own risk.

useBrowser.label: Use browser
useBrowser.description: Allows Caret to launch and interact with any website in the browser.

useMcp.label: Use MCP server
useMcp.description: Allows Caret to use configured MCP servers which can modify the file system or interact with APIs.

enableNotifications.label: Enable notifications
enableNotifications.description: Receive system notifications when Caret requires approval for a step or when a task is completed.

telemetry.label: Allow anonymous error and usage reporting
telemetry.description: You can help improve Caret by sending anonymous usage data and error reports. Anonymous usage and error data are sent to help improve the Caret product. No code, prompts, or personal information is ever sent, and no personal identifiable information is included.
